format: single Little Caesars restaurant franchise (leased site, 1,200 to 1,600 square feet)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a single Little Caesars® restaurant franchise ranges from $376,500 to $1,769,200. This includes $277,000 to $504,000 that must be paid to us or our affiliate.

fee.quote: Franchise fee. The standard initial franchise fee is $20,000. However, we reduce the initial franchise fee in certain circumstances, as described below in this item.
fee.note: Reduced by $5,000 (to $15,000) for honorably discharged U.S. military veterans and qualified first responders, waived for combat-disabled veterans and Gold Star families (first Restaurant only); $7,500 for a Food Truck. Fees collected last fiscal year ranged from $0 to $20,000. Also a $15,000 grand opening advertising fee paid to the franchisor (or $15,000 minimum self-spend).

royalty.quote: Royalty The greater of 6% of Gross Sales for each one-week period or $300 for each one-week period

adFund.quote: Advertising Fee Up to 7% of Gross Sales, as determined by us ... We allocate your total advertising obligation among contributions to a system-wide fund called Caesar Fund, contributions to an advertising cooperative (if applicable), and expenditures on local advertising.
adFund.note: Up to 7% of Gross Sales (unless the advertising Cooperative agrees to more), split by the franchisor among Caesar Fund, cooperative and local advertising. No current rate printed.

otherRecurring.name: Caesar Vision system annual support fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $3,750 per year per Restaurant; currently $3,120 per year per Restaurant (payable to Blue Line)

otherRecurring.name: Digital transactions fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $0.40 per transaction – currently $0.36, plus, if applicable, a third party aggregator fee of up to $0.10 per transaction

otherRecurring.name: Security and technology fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $0.09 per credit or debit transaction – currently $0.06

transferFee.amount: $5,000 per Restaurant for a transfer that changes control of the Franchisee or the Restaurant; $1,000 per Restaurant for a transfer that does not change control

item19.quote: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.
item19.note: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.

special: Required purchases from franchisor affiliate Blue Line: equipment and technology $235,000 to $460,000 before opening, opening order $7,000 to $9,000, and most food, paper products, supplies and equipment afterwards. This is why $277,000 to $504,000 of the investment is paid to the franchisor or its affiliate. Royalty has a $300 per week minimum. Refurbishment may be required every 5 years (up to $150,000).
issues: Advertising Fee current percentage not printed (only 'Up to 7%'). Item 19 not published. Investment assumes leased premises (one month's rent only).
